summary: Sloots Aardappelkweekbedrijf is a family-run potato breeding company in Eenrum, Groningen, Netherlands, that develops its own varieties for the starch, chips and fries industries, with a focus on disease resistance. The business goes back to 1968, when the father of Roelof Sloots began breeding potatoes for the starch industry.
founded: 1968 (breeding started; no formal founding date of the B.V. given)
ownership: Family-run; owner and breeder Roelof Sloots (took over in 2005)
products: Potato varieties for the starch industry
facts: 30 commercial varieties and 12 numbered selections in development listed
Breeding page refers to 58 years of experience
Roelof Sloots took over the company in 2005
Parent plants are trained along wires up to 2.5 m tall
